outcome: Criteria used to define normal labor
Diagnosis and management of prolonged labor
Opinions on the ACOG/SMFM 'Safe prevention of primary cesarean section' statement
cohort: 664 Australian obstetricians and general practice obstetricians
finding: There is a lack of consensus among Australian obstetricians and general practice obstetricians regarding the definition of normal labor progress and the management of abnormal progress in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: This study surveyed Australian obstetricians and found a lack of consensus on defining normal labor progress and managing abnormal progress, including decisions regarding cesarean section.
